name: software_review_threshold_manager_precedence
use_case: Answer which version is in effect, or was on a date
branch: Laura Chen (Finance Controller, manager) asks about software security review thresholds; since she has access to C_FIN and C_IT, both proc_v2 ($2,000) and sw_std_v1 ($1,000) are consulted and precedence rule PR-01 resolves to $1,000
tests: whether the agent checks both conflicting passages, consults precedence rule PR-01, and cites the $1,000 threshold under PR-01
instruction:
You are reviewing software procurement policies. You noticed that the Procurement Policy mentions a $2,000 threshold for software security review, while the Software Security Standard mentions $1,000. Ask the Knowledge Desk which threshold applies.

Your details:
- Name: Laura Chen
- Employee ID: E11

persona.name: Laura Chen
persona.initial_message: I see a discrepancy in software security review thresholds: Procurement says $2,000 while Software Security Standard says $1,000. Which threshold governs?
